abilities.effect: A pair of derghodaemons rise up from the floor to the north and southeast near the stairs; the daemons roll for initiative using Stealth, and fight to the death but do not pursue foes out of this area.
abilities.name: Conjure Daemon
abilities.trigger: A creature moves past the bend in the middle of the hall

hazard.description: Obscure magical runes hidden within the runes of the 16 named warriors bind a pair of derghodaemons into the walls of this hallway.
hazard.disable: Thievery DC 37 (expert) to remove a set of runes linked to one bound derghodaemon, or *dispel magic* (7th level, counteract DC 31) to counteract the trap's magic.
hazard.name: Test of Tactics
hazard.reset: If at least one of the derghodaemons survives, the trap resets after 1 hour, causing the surviving derghodaemons to be completely restored to full health and to merge with the floors.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
